summary: The diff implements TypedArray.of in its own file following all seven spec steps in order. IsConstructor is checked before TypedArrayCreateFromConstructor, which is called with ? and the length argument. The loop calls TypedArraySetElement with ? and no catch-alls or defaults are used. The only edits are in of.rs, plus a rename of the unused new_target parameter to _new_target. The change uses the existing support helpers and adds no new helper or file. Gate results are build ok, clippy ok, and 8 new passing tests with no regressions. I found no spec deviation, special-casing, or swallowed error.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. Optional style nit only: the IsConstructor check is done twice (ops::is_constructor, then a let-else on Value::Object with the same TypeError message). The second check is needed for type narrowing and does not change behaviour, so it can stay or be simplified.
